description: In a linear order, replacing negated equalities and negated strict comparisons by the specified finite disjunctions preserves each clause’s truth.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.positiveClause_correct.{u} {n : ℕ} {M : Type u}
  [LinearOrder M] (c : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.Clause true n) (x : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Formula.Realize (fun a b => a < b)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.clauseFormula c) x ↔
    ∃ d ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.positiveClause c,
      ∀ a ∈ d, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Formula.realizeAtom (fun a b => a < b) a x
